name: create_node_transform_stream
description: Implements a Transform stream that upper-cases and line-numbers text
prompts: Create linenumber.js exporting a class LineNumberStream (module.exports = { LineNumberStream }) that extends require('stream').Transform and transforms streamed text: it splits incoming data into lines and emits each line prefixed with its 1-based line number and a colon-space, e.g. '1: first line\n'. It must handle chunk boundaries that fall in the middle of a line (buffer the partial line until its newline arrives or the stream ends) and emit the final unterminated line, if any, in _flush. Assume utf8 text.
